monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured. The high-intent dropper-replacement guide defines exact bottle/closure fit, markings, materials, access control, care, a dry acceptance test, return path, and valid no-purchase outcomes without naming a merchant, live price, rating, discount, stock claim, product image, or invented testing. The potency guide retains its product-neutral path from compatible units to label, lot-report, arithmetic, and price-comparison checks.

image_qa.note: All three new pages are deliberately image-free: ArkRyder uses an IMAGE WITHHELD panel because no exact licensed cultivar image was selected, and the gear and unit guides use text, tables, and interface assets rather than generic or mismatched product art. The materially updated Blue Dream page retains one existing representative flower placement with explicit alt text and an on-page statement that it is not a verified cultivar or batch image; that retained placement was visually rechecked. No affiliate or product image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 report is six days old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, about 0.4% CTR, and average position 24.1. Blue Dream had 33 impressions, zero clicks, and average position about 47.6—the strongest non-legal page-volume signal—so the existing URL received a material evidence, opening, and internal-path expansion without a title rewrite or a cannibalizing new Blue Dream URL. None of the three genuinely new pages is labeled Data-led because the remaining two-impression 510-versus-disposable query, Delaware's two impressions, and one-impression rows were too weak, already served, or irrelevant. Legacy sitemap submission errors remain an owner-side Search Console cleanup item; the canonical sitemap and static legacy recovery endpoint were preserved and the new pages strengthen hub and reciprocal crawl paths.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready cannabis potency-unit translator grounded in current New York OCM, California DCC, and NIST sources, with explicit formulas, invalid-conversion gates, a six-field record, and reciprocal links from established label, CoA, lab-limit, edible-math, and price-comparison pages. Added an ArkRyder evidence matrix grounded in UW–Madison Extension, the Midwestern Hemp Database, AOSCA, and USDA, plus a product-neutral CBD dropper fit system grounded in FDA and glass-packaging standards. The Blue Dream update remains a focused Search Console reinforcement, while a source-review chronology release gate and public policy statement strengthen trust. Two qualified public or university opportunities are logged; no outreach was sent.
